column1: AN ACT TO REPEAL THE SRI LANKA  RAILWAYS AUTHORITY ACT, NO. 60
OF 1993; AND TO PROVIDE FOR MATTERS CONNECTED THEREWITH OR
BE it enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka as follows :—

column2: This Act  may  be  cited  as  the  Sri  Lanka  Railways

column1: Authority (Repeal) Act, No. 3  of 2005.

column2: The Sri Lanka Railways Authority Act, No. 60 of 1993,

column1: is hereby repealed.

column2: (1)  Notwithstanding  the  repeal  of  the  Sri  Lanka

column1: Railways Authority Act,  No.  60  of  1993  by  section  2,  all
moneys lying, on the date of commencement of this Act, to
the credit of the Sri Lanka Railways Authority established by
the Sri Lanka Railways Authority Act, No. 60 of 1993 shall,
with  effect  from  such  date,  stand  transferred  to  the
Consolidated  Fund.

column2: (a) All proceedings instituted in any court or tribunal

column1: by or against the Sri Lanka Railways Authority established
under the repealed Act and pending on the day preceding the
date  of  commencement  of  this Act,  shall  be  deemed,  with
effect  from  the  date  of  commencement  of  this Act,  to  be
proceedings instituted by or against the Railways Department
and be proceeded with accordingly.

column2: (b) All judgments, decrees or orders entered by any court

column1: or tribunal, in favour of, or against, the Sri Lanka Railways
Authority  shall  be  deemed  with  effect  from  the  date  of
commencement of this Act, to be judgments, decrees or orders
entered in favour of, or against the Railways Department and
shall be enforced accordingly.
